title: The $E_6$ normal forms: semisimple deformations, geometry, DT invariants, and the $E_{6,\infty}$ order
summary: We study the completed Jacobi algebras of $x^3+xy^3+p(y)$ for $\operatorname{ord}_yp=n\ge4$. The explicit normal-form morsification, the filtered length and centre proofs, and the cyclic terminal identities give finite free semisimple deformations. For every parameter of finite order we construct a polynomial curve neighbourhood and a local projective small contraction; the resulting geometric GV and Donaldson--Thomas calculations identify the block multiplicities.
